dct_creator_sm: Umaña Sedó, Sebastián (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5842-2378
dct_description_sm: These supplementary materials are a questionnaire that was used to identify factors associated with perinatal mortality in Canadian dairy farms and a causal diagram figure for the paper titled "Exploring herd-level perinatal calf mortality risk factors in eastern Canadian dairy farms". In total 19 factors were selected.
dct_title_s: Exploring herd-level perinatal mortality risk factors in Canadian dairy farms
